My dear [Christabel](/person/329)
Here are the [Answers](/topic/104) All to one question! I have read Hanbury Mills once to myself and am now reading it to poor [Gertrude](/person/1462) who enjoys it exceedingly – I like it very much indeed – there is so much character in the three degrees of refusement, and all the people seem to me very successful- Wilfred and Frank especially & Mrs Bridgewater and Joe.

By the by in 108 & 9 you have twice made Prince Rupert speak, if one goes by the Antecedents & Nominatives - I think the hitch is why Scott never suspected Foster first or last till Joe discovered it.

But the way Patience is raised is very touching and charming – I think it has more life in it than Lady Betty Pray send me more Face
your affectionate

C M Yonge
